001: Haoran, what do you usually like to do on weekends?
I really like going to the park for a run. How about you?
I prefer reading at home. I find it peaceful.
Reading is nice too, but I feel especially great after exercising.
Then maybe I'll try getting up early for a run next time too.
Sure, I'll call you on the weekend morning so we can go together.
002: What do you think of the coffee at this place?
It tastes good, but I prefer the one at the shop next door.
Really? I've never been to the one next door.
I'll take you there to try it next time. Their latte is especially good.
Hearing you say that, I'm actually starting to look forward to it.
It's settled then. We'll go tomorrow afternoon.
003: Jingyi, do you like eating spicy food?
I love it, especially Sichuan hot pot.
Really? I can't handle any spice at all.
That's a shame. Spicy food is really exciting to eat.
I do really like sweets though, like cake.
Then our tastes are pretty far apart.
004: Zixuan, what type of movies do you like to watch?
I prefer sci-fi films. I think the special effects are stunning.
I watch sci-fi too, but I like comedies more.
Comedies are good too. They put you in a better mood after watching.
Right, I just like that lighthearted feeling.
Next time a new comedy comes out, let's go see it together.
005: Do you usually like to keep any plants?
I really like growing succulents. I think they're super easy to care for.
Succulents are indeed cute. I've tried growing them, but I could never do it well.
Maybe you were watering them too much. You need to water them a bit less.
So that's how it is. I'll try again when I get home.
If it still doesn't work out, I'll give you one of the ones I've grown well.
006: Jiaqi, what type of music do you like to listen to?
I prefer pop music. How about you?
I like classical music more. It's very relaxing to listen to.
I listen to classical music occasionally too, but I don't really understand it.
You don't need to understand it. As long as it sounds good, that's enough.
Then do you have any songs you'd recommend?
007: Tianyou, do you like going shopping on the weekends?
Not really. I prefer staying home and playing video games.
What's so fun about playing video games? It's so much better to get out and about.
Different things have their own fun. Don't force me.
Fine then. Next time I'll find someone else to go with.
008: Do you prefer cats or dogs?
I prefer dogs. I think they're especially loyal.
I actually prefer cats. I think they're very independent.
Cats do have a lot of personality, but dogs are more clingy.
Each has its own merits. It depends on personal preference.
Right, as long as you like what you like.
009: Junjie, what kind of tea do you like to drink?
I prefer green tea. I think it's more refreshing.
I like black tea. It feels warmer on the stomach.
Drinking black tea in winter is indeed very comfortable.
Yeah, and in summer I drink more green tea.
So it seems you pick your tea based on the season.
010: Yuxuan, what kind of exercise do you usually like to do?
I like swimming. I feel like it works out your whole body.
Swimming is indeed great, but I prefer playing badminton.
Badminton is good too. It requires two people to work together.
Next time you're free, let's go play together.
Sure! I'm not very good at it though, so you'll have to teach me a lot.
